title: Who May Subscribe: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions Entry Terms
content:
A Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product is sold only to a person of at least the minimum age shown below who holds a Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program. The entry terms are the same for all six subscriptions.

| Subscription | Minimum age of the buyer (years) | Summit membership required |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 18 | Yes |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 18 | Yes |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 18 | Yes |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 18 | Yes |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 18 | Yes |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 18 | Yes |

### The age term on both sides (hypothetical buyers)

- A buyer aged 18 meets the minimum age of 18 years for every subscription.
- A buyer aged 17 does not meet it for any subscription.

### The membership term

No subscription is sold to a person without a Summit membership; the requirement reads "Yes" for every subscription in the table, so no tier is exempt from it.
